entities.name: Zoran Dragić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zoran Dragić is a Slovenian professional basketball player who plays for Split of the Croatian League and ABA League. He also represents the Slovenian national basketball team internationally. Standing at 1.96 m, he plays the shooting guard and small forward positions. He is the younger brother of Goran Dragić.
